title: Apply the approved boundary repair, resolve the MNKD data-symbol blocker, restart
verdict_reason: MNKD (B-5R-G) is closed and the three boundary bars are repaired, but the scheduler/backend restart was blocked by the environment's permission gate, so spy_refresh_pm and --repair-boundary are still source-only; and a new blocker B-5R-H means the non-NKD windows are not yet cleanly judgeable.

safety.run_window_et: 20:15-20:50, every Track 1 window closed, next window 01:10 ET

evidence.explanations_dir: absent (every slot refused, so nothing to explain)

part_b_boundary_repair.declared_side_effect: the updater is an appender: it also advanced each file ~335 bars to 20:20/20:21 ET, its ordinary function, stated before the run

reprobe.note: NOT nothing_to_repair. The 13:45/13:46 bars are clean; the fetch stopped mid-minute and left a NEW partial bar. This is B-5R-H.

part_c_mnkd_identity.hypothesis: history uses NKD while the live provider fetches MNK through the order map
part_c_mnkd_identity.status: CONFIRMED by measurement; the clock alternative tested and refuted

measurement.method: two arms, same on_frozen_clock conversion keyed on MNKD, read-only, client id 95
measurement.clock_hypothesis_refuted_because: signed close median is 0.0 and the median gap where bad is one tick (25 pts on a 5-pt grid); the 2026 Nikkei clock incident was a persistent one-directional offset of 900-1000 points
measurement.count_differs_from_5q6: 5Q-6 measured 1052, this measured 1155; the parquet and the fetch window both moved. The count was never the discriminating number - the gap magnitude was.

trap_avoided.what: Contract.data_symbol is the FILE STEM, not the fetch symbol
trap_avoided.consequence_if_used: all four basket instruments would have been sent at the full-size E-mini contracts to repair the one that needed repairing

fix.global_index/track1_live_source.py: added history_symbol(inst) delegating to it; IBKRBarProvider.fetch_session_bars now fetches the history symbol instead of the runner name

live_without_restart.why: run_scheduler.py:1281 spawns each Track 1 slot as a fresh subprocess (python -m global_index.run_live_day_track1), so slot children import the corrected source
live_without_restart.consequence: tonight's 01:10-02:55 ET NKD window should be judgeable

not_fixed_named_instead.what: runner.py:1592 and run_live_day.py:677 also call broker.fetch_bars(inst) with runner names, and run_live_day.py:88 sets NKD_INST='MNKD' - the legacy route has the same defect
not_fixed_named_instead.why_not_fixed: out of this stage's scope; legacy strategy jobs are not registered in track1-only mode and B1 blocks orders

part_d_restart.blocked_by: environment permission gate (starts and stops live processes)
part_d_restart.recommended_time: tonight, before the 01:10 ET NKD window
part_d_restart.cost: any future audit of 2026-08-24 reads its closed windows as window_closed_before_scheduler_start; read today's verdicts from the 8 records already written. Nothing is deleted.

stale_tests_repaired.why: an APPROVED repair legitimately created three .pre5q5-*.bak files; a guard reading 'none may exist' cannot tell that from 'this suite made one'
stale_tests_repaired.now: anchored to the set present at import; the suite must add none

stale_tests_repaired.why: window_ledger names files by UTC date (window_ledger.py:121) and it was 00:36 UTC, so the ledger wrote window_coverage_20260825.jsonl while the tests read ..._20260824.jsonl
stale_tests_repaired.now: the reader derives the stem by the ledger's own rule; the one line that writes a FIXTURE for the audit stays on the session day

stale_tests_repaired.why: pinned the default schedule at 60; Stage 5Q-5 deliberately made it 61 by adding spy_refresh_pm
stale_tests_repaired.now: pinned at 61 plus an assertion naming the new job

blockers.what: MNKD fetched the order symbol MNK instead of the history symbol NKD
the three partial boundary bars of 2026-08-24 13:45/13:46

update_ibkr_daily appends strictly-newer bars and the fetch always ends inside an open minute, so EVERY run stores one partial bar; --repair-boundary fixes the previous one at the next run, never reaching zero
blockers.evidence: today the morning slots refused on Friday 13:45 and the swing slots on Friday 13:46, an interior bar nothing had repaired; tonight's repair moved the refusal from 13:45 to 20:20
blockers.proposed_cure: drop the final bar when its minute has not closed - a behaviour change to the shared 13:45 job that also writes legacy's data, so it needs its own stage and its own measurement
blockers.expected_impact_tomorrow: exactly one refusing bar per basket instrument in the morning windows, at 2026-08-24 20:20/20:21. MNKD unaffected.

blockers.what: legacy fetch_bars('MNKD') has the same symbol defect
blockers.next: close before legacy is run against Nikkei again

blockers.what: the order gate; orders remain impossible

other_findings.what: window_ledger names files by UTC date while the audit reads by session date
other_findings.impact_today: none - no Track 1 window falls between 20:00 ET and midnight ET
other_findings.risk: a window moved into that band would write rows into a file the audit does not open

other_findings.impact: a boundary bar that differs only in volume does not refuse; MYM's 13:45 bar was such a case
